summary: A disconnected install uses the setup bundle with RPM dependencies available through dnf; leave out registry_username and registry_password and set bundle_install=true and bundle_dir.
questions: How do I run a disconnected containerized AAP install?
Which variables do I set for a bundled install?
Do I remove registry credentials for an offline install?

answer_card.title: Disconnected install
answer_card.answer_md:
Inventory:
```ini
bundle_install=true
bundle_dir=<full_path_to_bundle>/bundle
# no registry_username / registry_password
```
Then run `ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.install`.
